children.name: Gripper Manipulation Models
children.description: Simple grippers such as two-finger parallel grippers; single-arm and bimanual systems.
children.description_zh: 以两指平行夹爪等简单夹持器为主要研究平台，包括单臂和双臂系统。

children.name: Benchmarks
children.description: Dexterous-hand evaluation tasks, data, environments, and protocols. Distinguish published support from demonstrated configurations.
children.description_zh: 灵巧手操作评测任务、数据、环境与评分协议；区分论文声明、公开资产和实际评测配置。

children.name: Navigation Action Models
children.description: Includes point-goal, object-goal, and language-guided navigation, exploration, and navigation trajectory generation. The focus is reaching or finding a target using environmental observations; locomotion execution can be linked as a related area.
children.description_zh: 包括点目标导航、物体目标导航、语言导航、探索与导航轨迹生成。重点是利用环境观测到达或找到目标；涉及行走执行时，可关联身体运动与全身控制板块。

children.name: Body Motion and Whole-Body Control Models
children.name_zh: 身体运动与全身控制模型
children.description: Includes locomotion, balance, motion tracking, getting up, dynamic motor skills, and coordinated body control. Loco-manipulation belongs here when body coordination, balance, or motion execution is the main research question; manipulation can be noted as a related area.
children.description_zh: 包括行走、平衡、动作跟踪、起身、复杂运动技能与身体协同控制。行走操作以身体协同、平衡或动作执行为主要研究问题时归入本类，并可关联操作板块。
